recognize_zh: 背景為多顆染色質粗塊狀的小淋巴球；兩個箭頭指向較大的淋巴細胞，細胞質較多、染色質較不緻密，代表 CLL 中混雜的較大細胞（疑似 prolymphocyte）；左下有一顆被壓碎的細胞（smudge cell）。
features: Background of small lymphocytes with coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Arrowed cells are larger lymphoid cells with more abundant pale blue cytoplasm and less condensed chromatin
Nucleoli not sharply resolved in the arrowed cells at this image quality
Irregular crushed lymphoid nucleus (smudge-type cell) at lower left
Normal neutrophil and a granulated mononuclear cell with folded nucleus for size comparison
Red cells normocytic without significant abnormality
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous small lymphocytes with coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Admixed are larger lymphoid cells (arrows) with more abundant pale cytoplasm and somewhat less condensed chromatin; distinct central nucleoli are not clearly resolved at this resolution. A crushed smudge-type cell, a neutrophil and a granulated mononuclear cell are also present. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with admixed larger cells; if prolymphocytes are confirmed, their proportion should be quantified.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytic disease is defined by a predominance of medium-sized cells with a prominent central nucleolus, not a minority of larger cells among block-chromatin small lymphocytes.
MCL shows more pleomorphic, irregular nuclei and requires CD23, CD200 and cyclin D1/SOX11 testing to exclude.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or atypical lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells or contains azurophilic granules and occur without a monotonous small-lymphocyte background.
